decision_notes: Website stage decisions for Switch Willo Stables (HORSE_OWNER). All 24 person evidence blocks reviewed; two owner People retained. Phoebe Johnson is observed as FOUNDER, OWNER & TRAINER on the official About/Team pages and as 'Phoebe & Glenn Johnson Facility Owners' on the Contact page — satisfies the Horse Owner target-role model as primary contact. Glenn Johnson is observed as OWNER & TRAINER on About/Team (homepage 'Head Trainer') — retained as the second selected contact because the official site documents shared facility ownership and operational responsibility (large multi-program stable: lessons, boarding, camp). The homepage 'Pheobe Johnson — Owner' is a misspelling duplicate of Phoebe Johnson and is not retained separately. CONTACTS: Company phone 512-695-5269 corroborates the existing Twenty primary exactly (no_change expected). Program emails camp@/lessons@/boarding@switchwillo.com and program phones 512-565-5983 / 760-908-1301 are generic Company program contacts — retained for Company composite append only; they never populate Person fields and do not satisfy named-contact contactability. ckw.sws@gmail.com (listed beside Cindi Wallace, Barn Manager) is a personal webmail address — REJECTED for canonical write; flagged as a personal-email candidate for human review only, consistent with the personal-data boundary. Image-URL artifacts extracted as phones (1784.../1778.../2026-07-17 etc.) are rejected as extraction noise. SOCIALS: official facebook.com/switchwillo, instagram.com/switchwillo and instagram.com/campswitchwillo retained for Company composite append; instagram.com/averyfletcherphotography is a third-party photographer credit, rejected. No website Person carries a professional email/phone, so both retained People proceed to FullEnrich Contact Enrichment; no FullEnrich Search is needed because website-verified owners were retained.
